moments.title: "Our husband will handle it" — and why that answer does not hold
moments.summary: The argument of the piece: women run the house, the kids and the calendar but defer on mutual funds, and if they help build the life then the family's wealth is theirs too.
moments.evidence: But when someone says, mutual funds, we say our husband will handle it. And honestly, why?

moments.title: You don't have to become a finance expert — just take part in the decisions
moments.summary: The ask is deliberately small: not becoming a finance expert overnight, but participating in the decisions and conversations that shape your future, and the closing line that finance feels less scary when it is explained simply.
moments.evidence: So no, we don't need to become finance experts overnight. But we do need to start participating in decisions and conversations that shape our future.
